rationale: geometry/isolation thresholds cannot depend on which atolls later survive plant-inventory response quality
spatial_block_selection_rule: choose the largest frozen graph radius whose connected-component partition has at least 11 components and whose largest component contains no more than 50 percent of all 310 atolls; STOP if no radius qualifies
source_pressure_scale: median centroid nearest-neighbour distance among all 310 atolls
generic_gateway_rule: at a frozen graph radius, component contains an atoll with major_landmass_distance <= that same radius
